summary: Dr. Joseph V. Connole, Wilkes-Barre eye, ear, nose and throat specialist and First World War Navy eye surgeon; John's 1st cousin 4 times removed.
bio:
Joseph Vincent Connole was born in 1889 at Plymouth, Pa., a son of John F. Connole. He became a physician specialising in the eye, ear, nose and throat, and practised in Wilkes-Barre.

In October 1917, during the First World War, he enlisted in the United States Navy and served for two years as a senior lieutenant in charge of eye work at the Philadelphia Navy Yard. He arrived at New York as a ship's passenger in 1936 and was still living in Wilkes-Barre in 1940.
